name: Gets all projects for the given organization
description: Gets all projects for the given organization Returns a paginated list of projects for the specified organization. GET /v1/organizations/{slug}/projects
context:
GET /v1/organizations/{slug}/projects
Returns a paginated list of projects for the specified organization. This endpoint uses offset-based pagination. Use the `offset` parameter to skip a number of projects and the `limit` parameter to control the number of projects returned per page.
Required: slug (path) — Organization slug
Optional: offset (query) — Number of projects to skip; limit (query) — Number of projects to return per page; search (query) — Search projects by name; sort (query) — Sort order for projects; statuses (query) — A comma-separated list of project statuses to filter by. The following values are supported: `ACTIVE_HEALTHY`, `INACTIVE`.
